telegramLifecycle.prepareDescription: Stage an organization-owned Telegram bot and verify bot identity, authenticated webhook receipt, command registration, and private delivery while your current bot continues serving open approvals.
telegramLifecycle.privateTestSent: Synthetic private test message delivered to Telegram.
telegramLifecycle.restoreStarted: Restore prepared. Complete fresh verification and impact review before reactivating.
telegramLifecycle.retiringDescription: Retiring bots keep servicing open approval cards they already sent until all open cards settle or the 30-day retirement deadline is reached.
telegramLifecycle.revoked: Revoked Telegram installation immediately. Pending approvals remain available in Z8.
telegramLifecycle.revokeDescription: Immediately stops local authorization and queues generation-fenced webhook cleanup. Open approvals stay accessible in Z8.
telegramLifecycle.rotated: Rotated Telegram bot token while preserving installation, conversations, and webhook route.

steps.commandsHint: Registers the 11 Z8 slash commands independently so failures can be retried without changing credentials.
steps.commandsPassed: Registered all 11 Z8 commands in the Telegram bot menu.
steps.identityHint: Verifies the numeric Telegram bot ID and claims ownership before changing webhook settings.
steps.privateDeliveryHint: Sends a synthetic private test message to your candidate Telegram chat (never production notifications or approvals).
steps.webhookReceiptAwaiting: Webhook registered. Send /start to your new bot on Telegram to confirm authenticated inbound receipt.
steps.webhookReceiptPassed: Confirmed via authenticated inbound Telegram webhook matching this installation and secret.
steps.webhookReceiptPending: Registers the installation-scoped webhook and waits for an authenticated Telegram update.

telegramLifecycle.switchDescription: Review employee reachability, open approval cards, and in-flight work before switching. Existing open cards stay serviceable on the retiring bot during the 30-day retirement window.
telegramLifecycle.switched: Switched to the verified organization-owned Telegram bot. Existing open approval cards remain serviceable during retirement.
telegramLifecycle.switchGateDisabled: Telegram switching is currently gated off for this organization. Complete verification above so you are ready when enabled.
telegramLifecycle.testChatIdLabel: Candidate Telegram chat ID (optional if enrolled)
telegramLifecycle.webhookRetried: Telegram webhook registered. Send a private message to the new bot to confirm authenticated receipt.

discordLifecycle.prepareDescription: Verify application identity, signed interactions, slash commands, and private DM delivery while your current Discord bot keeps serving employees.
discordLifecycle.endpointHelp: Save credentials below first, then paste this URL into the Discord Developer Portal so Discord sends a signed PING.
discordLifecycle.dmTestLabel: Test private DM delivery (Discord User ID)
discordLifecycle.dmTestHelp: Enter your numeric Discord User ID. If Discord returns error 50007, ensure you share a server with the bot and enable server Direct Messages.
discordLifecycle.switchDescription: Review verified Discord DM reachability, open approval cards, and in-flight notifications before switching.
discordLifecycle.gateDisabledNotice: Organization-owned Discord switching is not yet enabled for this organization. You can prepare, test, and review impact now.
discordLifecycle.ackUnreadyLabel: I acknowledge that {count} employees still need to link or verify Discord direct messages on the replacement bot.
discordLifecycle.retiringDescription: Retiring bots continue servicing eligible approval cards they originally sent until work settles or the 30-day deadline.
discordLifecycle.revokeHelp: Immediately stops Discord authorization while keeping pending approvals available in the Z8 inbox.
discordLifecycle.preparedAnnouncement: Replacement Discord bot staged. Copy the Interaction Endpoint URL and save your bot credentials.
discordLifecycle.credentialsSaved: Discord credentials verified and slash commands registered. Configure the Interaction Endpoint URL and run a private DM test next.
discordLifecycle.credentialsSavedCommandsFailed: Discord credentials verified, but slash command registration failed. Retry command registration below without re-entering credentials.
discordLifecycle.privateTestSucceeded: Synthetic private DM delivered and verified.
discordLifecycle.switchedAnnouncement: Switched to the verified organization-owned Discord bot. Previous approval cards remain serviced during retirement.
discordLifecycle.rotatedAnnouncement: Discord bot token rotated cleanly while preserving conversations and approval card ownership.
discordLifecycle.revokedAnnouncement: Discord installation revoked immediately. Pending approvals remain accessible in the Z8 inbox.
discordLifecycle.restoreStartedAnnouncement: Restore started. Complete fresh signed endpoint and private DM verification before confirming switch-back.
discordLifecycle.endpointCopyFailed: Could not copy URL. Select and copy it manually.

steps.identityDesc: Verifies bot token, Application ID, and Ed25519 Public Key via Discord API and stores an immutable revision.
steps.signedEndpointDesc: Confirms Ed25519-signed traffic for this application ID. A signed PING alone does not confirm private DM reachability.
steps.commandsDesc: Tracked independently so registration errors can be retried without re-entering credentials.
steps.privateDmDesc: Sends a synthetic private DM to your Discord user ID to confirm real direct-message reachability.

revokeConfirm.title: Revoke Discord bot?
revokeConfirm.description: This immediately stops Discord delivery and callbacks for this installation. Pending approvals remain accessible in Z8.

errors.invalidBotTokenFormat: Enter a valid Discord bot token with no whitespace.
errors.invalidApplicationIdFormat: Application ID must be a numeric Discord snowflake ID.
errors.invalidPublicKeyFormat: Public key must be a 64-character hexadecimal Ed25519 key.
errors.invalidBotToken: Discord rejected the bot token. Check your bot credentials in the Discord Developer Portal.
errors.applicationIdMismatch: Application ID does not match the provided bot token.
errors.publicKeyMismatch: Public key does not match the Discord application.
errors.appClaimedByOtherOrg: This Discord application is already claimed by another Z8 organization.
errors.dmBlocked50007: Discord blocked this direct message (error 50007). Share a server with the bot, unblock the bot, and enable server Direct Messages in Discord Privacy Settings, then retry.
errors.missingAccess50001: The bot does not share a server with this Discord user (error 50001). Invite the bot to a shared server and retry.
errors.unknownUser10013: Discord could not find that user ID (error 10013). Copy your numeric User ID with Discord Developer Mode enabled.
errors.invalidDiscordUserId: Enter a valid numeric Discord user ID.
errors.switchNotEnabled: Switching to an organization-owned Discord bot is not yet enabled for this organization.
errors.migrationBlocked: Resolve migration blockers above before switching Discord bots.
errors.candidateNotReady: Complete application identity, signed interaction PING, and private DM verification before switching.
errors.candidateVerificationExpired: Candidate verification proofs have expired. Re-verify before switching.
errors.impactChanged: Switch impact or installation revisions changed since you reviewed them. Review the updated summary and confirm again.
errors.unreadyAckRequired: Acknowledge that some employees still need to connect or verify Discord DMs before switching.
errors.rotationIdentityMismatch: The provided token belongs to a different Discord application. Credential rotation requires the exact same Discord application.
errors.refreshFailed: Could not refresh Discord lifecycle status.
errors.prepareFailed: Could not prepare a replacement Discord bot.
errors.retryCommandsFailed: Slash command registration failed again. Verify your bot token and permissions, then retry.
errors.prepareRestoreFailed: Could not start restoring this Discord installation.
